description: Unofficial Tauri desktop client for DeepSeek Harness (DSH), with a managed runtime and preset plugins

suggest.extras/webview2: The embedded Harness UI needs the WebView2 Runtime (usually preinstalled on Windows 10+)

notes: This is the community build from the dsh-tauri project, not the official DeepSeek desktop app (https://www.deepseek.com/harness).
Turn off Settings -> Auto update after the first launch. The built-in updater runs the vendor installer and would create a second install outside Scoop; update with 'scoop update dsh-tauri' instead.
The first launch still downloads the Node runtime and Harness core into %APPDATA%\dsh-tauri; this installer does not include them.
Log-in autostart points at the versioned exe. Start the app once after 'scoop update' to refresh it, or keep autostart disabled.
